caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure rendered with a puppet-like, segmented appearance and positioned on a roughly rectangular wooden base. The figure has short black hair, light skin tone, and exaggerated wide eyes. It is dressed in a long-sleeved brown tunic with a high neck, decorated at the collar, cuffs, and waist with red and green bands. A large, yellow, circular ornament with a star motif is centered on the chest. The figure’s lower body is covered with patterned sections: diamond shapes of brown, red, and green, and crisscrossed lines on the thighs. The legs have tan knee-high footwear with laced details and blue-green bands just below the knees. The left arm is extended outward, and the right arm is down, holding by cords the bodies of two brown, presumably taxidermied or sculpted, animals. The background is plain beige, and the lower right is signed "Limarquina 38."
title: Santo
